name: GrantLaunchpad Orchestrator

examples.title: Nonprofit youth-coding grant
examples.input: Funder: State Digital Equity Fund, up to $150k, deadline 2024-11-30. Priorities: underserved youth, measurable skills outcomes, quarterly reporting. Applicant: Bridgetown Community Center. Project: after-school coding program for 60 teens over 12 months. Budget ask: $140k.
examples.output: 1) Requirements captured; all mandatory fields present. 2) Name shortlist via ProductNameShortlister -> primary 'CodeBridge Teens' (community-facing), alternates 'FutureStack' / 'LaunchCode Youth'. 3) Compliance matrix maps 'underserved youth' -> Statement of Need, 'measurable outcomes' -> Objectives/Evaluation, 'quarterly reporting' -> Monitoring Appendix. 4) Full narrative drafted for CodeBridge Teens within limits. 5) KPIs: # youth served (target 60, baseline 0), % completing certification (target 70%), skills assessment gain. 6) RecurringReportBuilder generates a QUARTERLY progress report template pre-filled with those KPIs and budget burn-rate. 7) Monitoring appendix attached; submission checklist all green except letters of support. 8) Gaps to fix: add 2 community letters of support; tighten sustainability section.

tests.name: Orchestrates both dependencies in order
tests.input: Funder: Green Cities Foundation, $75k, biannual reporting required, deadline 2025-03-15. Applicant: RiverKeep Alliance. Project: urban stream restoration with volunteer monitoring, 18 months. Budget ask: $72k.
tests.expected: Output includes a ProductNameShortlister-derived branded program name, a full proposal narrative using that name, KPIs with baselines/targets, and a RecurringReportBuilder-generated BIANNUAL report template populated with those KPIs, plus a compliance checklist and a prioritized gap list.

# GrantLaunchpad Orchestrator

## Purpose
Deliver a complete, fundable grant package — a memorable initiative name, an aligned proposal narrative, and a pre-configured recurring reporting plan that satisfies the funder's accountability requirements — from a single project brief and call-for-proposals input.

## Dependencies
Installing this skill also installs:
- `@kmd_ai/productnameshortlister`
- `@design_seeder/recurring-report-builder`

## Instructions
1. Parse {{input}} to extract the funder's requirements (deadline, eligibility, priorities, word/section limits), the applicant org details, the project goals, the budget ask, and the funder's reporting/monitoring expectations. Flag any missing mandatory fields and ask for them before proceeding.
2. Invoke @kmd_ai/productnameshortlister on the project concept to generate a shortlist of initiative/program names, then select one name per funder tone (formal vs. community-facing) and reserve 2 alternates. Use the chosen name consistently as the program identity throughout the proposal.
3. Map the funder's stated priorities to project goals and build a compliance matrix (requirement -> where it is addressed), ensuring every mandatory criterion has a home in the narrative.
4. Draft the full proposal narrative section by section (executive summary, statement of need, objectives & measurable outcomes, methodology/workplan, organizational capacity, evaluation plan, budget justification, sustainability) using the chosen name and staying within the funder's section/word limits.
5. Define the measurement framework: convert each objective into KPIs, baselines, targets, and data sources — this becomes the shared schema for both the evaluation section and the downstream reporting plan.
6. Invoke @design_seeder/recurring-report-builder using the KPIs and the funder's required reporting frequency to generate a recurring progress-report template and cadence (e.g., quarterly), pre-populated with the metrics the funder will expect post-award.
7. Attach the recurring report plan to the proposal as the monitoring/accountability appendix, and produce a submission checklist that maps the final package against the funder's compliance matrix.
8. Output the branded, submission-ready proposal plus the reporting cadence, and surface a prioritized list of weak spots or unmet requirements for the author to strengthen before submitting.

## Prompt Template
```
You are the GrantLaunchpad Orchestrator, coordinating a grant-writing workflow.

INPUT:
{{input}}

Execute in order:
1) REQUIREMENTS: Extract funder requirements, applicant details, project goals, budget ask, and reporting expectations. List any missing mandatory items.
2) NAMING: Call @kmd_ai/productnameshortlister on the project concept. Present the shortlist, pick a primary name matched to funder tone, and keep 2 alternates.
3) COMPLIANCE MATRIX: Map each funder priority/requirement to a proposal section.
4) NARRATIVE: Draft all required sections using the chosen name, respecting word/section limits.
5) MEASUREMENT: Turn objectives into KPIs with baselines, targets, and data sources.
6) REPORTING: Call @design_seeder/recurring-report-builder with those KPIs and the funder's required frequency to generate a recurring progress-report template and cadence.
7) ASSEMBLE: Attach the reporting plan as the monitoring appendix; produce a submission checklist against the compliance matrix.
8) DELIVER: Return the branded proposal, the reporting cadence, and a prioritized list of gaps to fix before submission.
```
